name: Henry Teen Art Collective
what_you_do: A weekly group of teens. They go behind the scenes at the museum and meet artists and creative workers. They make projects like zines, art shows and videos.
who_can_apply: High school students in the Seattle area who care about modern art.
duration: Weekly meetings through the school year
deadline_text: Dates for this year are not posted on the pages read. The only call for applications found was for 2023-24 (deadline Oct 10, 2023), so check the Henry teen page.
how_to_apply: Submit the Call for Applications form on the Henry teen page when it is open.
notes: The teen page lists ages 14 to 18 but the application page found is old (2023). The page does not state cost; confirm cost and the current cycle before relying on it.
